#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

struct Node {
    int row, col, dist;
};

const int dx[4] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
const int dy[4] = {0, -1, 0, 1};
queue<Node> q;
char s[15];
int n, n1, m, lim, tot, p;
int a[11][11], b[11][11], d0[11][11], f[202][202], d[202][202], w[202], h[202], g[203];
bool t, flag, ok[12][12], okb[12][12];

void search(int x, int z) {
    if (x == n + 1) {
        p = z;
        flag = true;
        return;
    }
    int temp = n + 2;
    for (int y = 0; y <= n + 1; ++y) {
        if (d[x][y] < f[x][y]) {
            temp = min(temp, h[y]);
            if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                w[++tot] = y;
                search(y, min(z, f[x][y] - d[x][y]));
                if (!t || flag) return;
                w[tot--] = 0;
            }
        }
        if (d[y][x] > 0) {
            temp = min(temp, h[y]);
            if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                w[++tot] = -y;
                search(y, min(z, d[y][x]));
                if (!t || flag) return;
                w[tot--] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    if (temp + 1 != h[x]) {
        --g[h[x]];
        if (g[h[x]] == 0) t = false;
        h[x] = temp + 1;
        ++g[h[x]];
    }
}

bool improvable() {
    flag = false;
    p = n1;
    tot = 0;
    w[0] = 0;
    search(0, n1);
    return flag;
}

void improve() {
    for (int x = 1; x <= tot; ++x) {
        if (w[x] > 0)
            d[abs(w[x - 1])][w[x]] += p;
        else
            d[-w[x]][abs(w[x - 1])] -= p;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int m_input, lim_input;
    cin >> m_input >> lim_input;
    m = m_input;
    lim = lim_input;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        cin >> s + 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            if (s[j] == 'Z') {
                Node he = {i, j, 0};
                q.push(he);
            } else if (s[j] != 'Y') {
                ok[i][j] = true;
                d0[i][j] = lim;
                int k = s[j] - '0';
                if (k > 0) {
                    a[i][j] = ++n;
                    f[0][n] = k;
                    n1 += k;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    memcpy(okb, ok, sizeof(ok));
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        cin >> s + 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            if (s[j] == 'Z' || s[j] == 'Y') continue;
            int k = s[j] - '0';
            if (k > 0) {
                b[i][j] = ++n;
                f[n][m * m + 1] = k;
            }
        }
    }
    if (n != m * m) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                    int k = b[i][j];
                    f[k][n + 1] = f[k][m * m + 1];
                    f[k][m * m + 1] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    while (!q.empty()) {
        Node he = q.front(); q.pop();
        int i = he.row, j = he.col;
        d0[i][j] = he.dist;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            int ni = i + dx[k], nj = j + dy[k];
            if (ok[ni][nj]) {
                Node e = {ni, nj, he.dist + 1};
                q.push(e);
                ok[ni][nj] = false;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
            memcpy(ok, okb, sizeof(okb));
            ok[i][j] = false;
            Node he = {i, j, 0};
            q.push(he);
            while (!q.empty()) {
                Node he = q.front(); q.pop();
                int x = he.row, y = he.col;
                if (b[x][y] > 0 && he.dist <= d0[x][y]) {
                    f[a[i][j]][b[x][y]] = n1;
                }
                if (he.dist + 1 > lim || he.dist >= d0[x][y]) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                    if (ok[nx][ny]) {
                        Node e = {nx, ny, he.dist + 1};
                        q.push(e);
                        ok[nx][ny] = false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    g[0] = n + 2;
    t = true;
    while (t && h[0] <= n + 2) {
        while (improvable()) {
            improve();
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        ans += d[i][n + 1];
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
